**Key takeaways**

*   **Stay with Tidio if you are a small or mid-sized team or an online store.** Chat, email, Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp and Lyro share one inbox, and a free plan lets you test it.
*   **Best for stores with a big ticket queue: Gorgias.** It prices by ticket volume, not by seat, and shows order data beside every ticket.
*   **Best for AI-first teams that can budget for usage: Intercom.** Fin is billed at $0.99 per outcome on top of seats.
*   **Best flat team price: Crisp.** One workspace price covers 4 seats on Mini.
*   **Best free option: tawk.to.** The platform is free, and AI Assist and badge removal are $29 a month each.
*   **Best for deep ticketing: Freshdesk and Zendesk.** Both cost more per agent once chat and AI are included.

Tidio is an AI customer service platform that puts live chat, email, social messages and the Lyro AI agent in one inbox, and it holds a 4.6 rating on G2. It fits small and mid-sized teams and online stores well. It is a Tidio blog, so you should know the bias: we think Tidio is a strong pick for that group, and this page says when it is not. Plans are metered by separate conversation, Lyro and Flows quotas, and a very large queue with strict SLAs may suit an enterprise desk better. We compared 10 tools that replace Tidio's core job, a chat widget with a shared inbox and AI, and checked every pricing page and G2 profile in October 2026. Each entry says where that tool falls short of Tidio.

## Tidio alternatives at a glance

Short answer: **Gorgias** for order-heavy stores, **Intercom** for AI-first chat, **Crisp** for a flat price, **tawk.to** for free chat, **Freshdesk** or **Zendesk** for deep ticketing.

# Best Intercom Alternatives in 2026: Namiru.ai vs Intercom vs Zendesk vs Tidio

If you are looking for an Intercom alternative that does not charge per seat and does not surprise you with hidden fees, you are not alone. Thousands of small businesses are switching away from expensive support platforms in 2026.

This comparison breaks down what you actually pay and what you actually get with four popular customer support tools: Intercom, Zendesk, Tidio, and Namiru.ai.

## Quick Comparison

| Feature | Namiru.ai | Intercom | Zendesk | Tidio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starting price | €0/mo (free plan) | $29/seat/mo | $55/agent/mo | $29/mo |
| Pricing model | Flat per plan | Per seat + usage | Per agent | Per plan + usage |
| Free plan | 20 conversations/mo | No (14-day trial) | No (14-day trial) | Limited free plan |
| AI conversations included | 2,000 (Starter) | $0.99 per AI resolution | AI add-on extra | Limited on free |
| Setup time | 30 seconds (paste URL) | Days to weeks | Days to weeks | 30-60 minutes |
| Auto-crawl website | Yes | No  | No  | No  |
| Pain point detection | Yes | No  | No  | No  |
| Lead capture | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Cost savings dashboard | Yes | No  | No  | No  |
| EU-hosted | Yes | US-hosted | US-hosted | EU option |
| Languages | 200+ auto-detect | 45+ | 40+ | 16  |
| Per-seat fees | None | $29-132/seat | $55-115/agent | None |
| Hidden AI fees | None | $0.99/resolution | Extra cost | Token limits |

## The Real Cost: What You Actually Pay Per Month

Pricing pages never tell the full story. Here is what a small business with 3 support agents and 2,000 monthly conversations actually pays.

### Intercom: $400-1,500+/month

Intercom's Essential plan starts at $29 per seat per month, which sounds reasonable. But that is just the beginning.

With 3 agents on the Advanced plan, you pay $255/month for seats alone. Then Intercom's AI agent Fin charges $0.99 per resolution. If Fin resolves 500 conversations per month, that adds $495. Need SMS or WhatsApp? Those cost extra per message. Want product tours or surveys? That is a $99/month add-on.

A realistic monthly bill for a small team: $400 to $1,500 depending on AI usage and messaging volume. The pricing is complex and unpredictable.

### Zendesk: $165-345+/month

Zendesk Suite Team starts at $55 per agent per month. For 3 agents, the base cost is $165/month. The Professional plan runs $115/agent, putting 3 agents at $345/month.

AI features are not included in the base price. Zendesk's AI agents and AI-powered tools require additional subscriptions. The setup process typically takes days, not minutes, and often requires a dedicated admin.

### Tidio: $29-59/month

Tidio starts with a free plan but limits you to 20 conversations. The Starter plan at $29/month gives you more, but AI chatbot conversations are capped. The Communicator plan adds live chat features at $29/month per operator.

Tidio is affordable for basic chat but lacks conversation intelligence, pain point detection, and auto-crawling.

### Namiru.ai: €0-59/month

Namiru.ai charges a flat fee with no per-seat pricing and no per-resolution fees.

The free plan gives you 20 conversations per month with a full analytics dashboard. The Starter plan at €29/month includes 2,000 AI conversations, custom themes, and email support. The Pro plan at €59/month adds 5,000 conversations, unlimited agents and domains, and removes Namiru branding.

No hidden fees. No per-agent charges. No surprise AI resolution costs. Your bill is the same every month.

## Setup: Minutes vs Weeks

This is where the difference is dramatic.

### Intercom and Zendesk

Both require significant setup time. You need to configure workflows, build conversation trees, write bot scripts, train the AI on your content, and integrate with your existing tools. For most businesses, this takes days to weeks with dedicated team involvement.

### Tidio

Tidio is faster to set up than Intercom or Zendesk. You can get a basic chatbot running in 30-60 minutes. But you still need to manually create conversation flows and write responses.

### Namiru.ai

Sign up. Paste your website URL. Done.

Namiru's auto-crawler reads your entire website and creates a knowledge base automatically. Your AI agent knows your business, your products, your pricing, and your policies within 30 seconds. No manual configuration, no conversation trees, no bot scripting.

You can also upload files (.txt, .pdf, .csv, .docx) or add text entries to expand the knowledge base.

## Conversation Intelligence: The Feature Gap

Most chat tools show you transcripts and basic metrics. Namiru.ai goes further.

Every conversation is analyzed by AI and tagged with intent, sentiment, topic, and pain point data. Your dashboard shows you:

*   Which pain points keep coming up and how severe they are
*   Which visitors are qualified leads ready to buy
*   Which customers are at risk of churning
*   How much money your AI is saving in support costs
*   What topics your customers ask about most
*   AI-generated weekly insights with actionable recommendations

None of the other tools in this comparison offer this level of conversation intelligence at this price point. Intercom has some analytics, but they require the Advanced or Expert plan at $85-132/seat. Zendesk requires Professional or Enterprise plans for advanced reporting. Tidio offers basic analytics but no pain point detection or AI-powered insights.

## Language Support

If you serve customers in multiple countries, language support matters.

Namiru.ai supports 200+ languages with automatic detection. A customer can write in Slovak, and the bot responds in Slovak. Another writes in French, and the bot responds in French. No configuration needed.

Intercom supports around 45 languages but requires additional setup for multi
